upstream.description: A straightforward method for training your LLM, from downloading data to generating text.

classification.analysis: train-llm-from-scratch is a heavily documented, hand-written PyTorch implementation of the full LLM lifecycle — tokenization, a from-scratch Transformer, pretraining, SFT, a Bradley-Terry reward model, and DPO/PPO/GRPO alignment — with no reliance on `transformers`, `trl`, or `peft`. It includes a MkDocs documentation site with diagrams for every stage, a Streamlit control panel for launching runs, and JSON-driven configs sized for anything from a free Colab T4 up to multi-billion-parameter models on an A100. It's explicitly written as a teaching resource for students, developers, and researchers who want to understand every algorithm (attention, GAE, GRPO/RLVR) by reading and running real, minimal code rather than a black-box library.

use_cases.title: Learn how a Transformer's attention and training loop work by reading minimal PyTorch code
Pretrain a small LLM from scratch on a single free-tier GPU
Implement DPO or GRPO alignment without depending on trl or peft
Run a full pretrain-to-chat pipeline via a Streamlit control panel
